name: The Arthur Diaries: Cellular Memories
source:
"Cellular Memories" propels players into a world of shadows and secrets, as Arthur races against time to apprehend a sadistic killer. As the body count rises and the city teeters on the brink of panic, Arthur's unwavering dedication to his craft becomes his most potent weapon. This gripping tale showcases Arthur's strength, resilience, and unwavering pursuit of justice, setting the stage for the remarkable chronicles that lay ahead in The Arthur Diaries series.

[from [url=https://aka-ashi.itch.io/cellular-memories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Cellular Memories》将玩家带入阴影与秘密交织的世界。亚瑟争分夺秒，追捕一个残忍的凶手。随着死者增多，城市濒临恐慌，亚瑟对本职工作坚定不移的投入，成为最强大的武器。这则扣人心弦的故事，展现了亚瑟的力量、韧性，以及对正义毫不动摇的追求，也为《The Arthur Diaries》系列后续的非凡经历拉开序幕。

[摘自[url=https://aka-ashi.itch.io/cellular-memories]itch.io[/url]]
